Scope: collector and local roads, potable water, sewerage, storm drainage, irrigation, medium-voltage, street lighting and telecom networks, a sewage pump station and storm drainage ponds for Block J. Contract value 117.4M SAR excluding VAT, 24 months.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted effort (man-days, the same basis as report 94). At the 03-Nov-2026 data date the project is 78.7% complete against 87.6% planned, behind by 8.9% (SPI 0.90). Since report 94 it gained 0.24% against 1.04% planned, so the gap widened again.

The project is now forecast to finish eight to ten months late. The P6 update of 03-Nov-2026 finishes the project on 20-Nov-2027, 313 days after the contract date of 11-Jan-2027, with −258 days of float. The weekly report forecasts 29-Sep-2027 (261 days late), the date the failed-start list also shows. Report 94's revised forecast of 18-Jan-2027 has been withdrawn. With 90.5% of the contract time used, 21.3% of the physical work remains, and every network completion milestone is between 196 and 258 days negative in P6.

Effort is measured in man-days (65,420 in total) on the same basis as report 94, but the line items were re-weighted: mobilisation was dropped and engineering, procurement, the networks and testing changed budgets. This week the report states 778 man-days earned (561 of them in testing and commissioning) against 912 planned; the cumulative earned total rose by only 158, because procurement fell from 12,670 to 12,485 and roads from 10,205 to 9,798. The P6 update (data date 03-Nov-2026) has 1,921 activities: 1,231 completed, 63 in progress and 627 not started. Its scheduled finish is 20-Nov-2027, 313 days after the contract date.

Data notes

Built from the W06 upload (report 95); the previous week's folder (report 94, updated workbook) was used for this-week changes.

  • The workbook's own date fields were not updated: the cover, General Information and Schedule sheets still show data date 27-Oct-2026, report 94 and contract week 93. The file name, the P6 update, the look-ahead and the failed-start list are dated 03-Nov-2026, so this report uses 03-Nov-2026 and week 94 (660 days from handover on 12-Jan-2025).
  • Progress basis: report 95 keeps the man-day basis of the updated report 94 (65,420 man-days), and this report uses the same basis. The figures cannot be compared with report 92 (man-hours).
  • The cover's physical progress total (89.99% planned, 74.16% earned, SPI 0.82) does not add up: its budget total is 96,167 man-days against 65,420 in the Progress sheet. This report uses the Progress sheet (87.64% planned, 78.71% earned), which the Arabic summary sheet also shows.
  • The report states 778 man-days earned this week, but the cumulative earned total rose by only 158 (51,333 to 51,491): procurement fell from 12,670 to 12,485, roads from 10,205 to 9,798, and mobilisation (188) was removed. Testing and commissioning again earns 561 man-days without any planned value or test started.
  • Three finish dates disagree: the weekly report and the failed-start list give 29-Sep-2027, the P6 file 20-Nov-2027, and the P6 extract in the Progress sheet shows handover on 07-Feb-2028. The milestone sheet's own schedule extract still lists the 18-Jan-2027 programme from the updated report 94.
  • The Arabic summary sheet changed its totals: roads are now in tonnes (55,631 t), storm, sewerage and potable water totals grew (for example storm 18,554 to 24,720 LM) and telecom was added. The Major Quantities sheet changed only for 200 mm water pipe (5,579 to 8,136 m) and lighting poles (126 to 169), while the activities sheet reports 100 m of water line this week.
  • The physical forecast in the chart data still reaches 100% in January 2027, against a P6 finish in November 2027. In the chart data the earned effort up to September equals the revised plan month by month.
  • Manpower and invoice sheets are unchanged from report 94 (every trade's plan equals its actual; next-month forecast 1,148). HSE hours this week are 12,000 but "this month" shows 6,000, and the HSE inspection sheet still covers 26-Aug to 01-Sep-2026.
  • The procurement log still has deliveries above the required quantity (sewer GRP 400 mm SN5000 1,138 of 261 m, potable water 160 mm 214 of 73 m, GRP liner 1,900 mm 43 of 32 m) and unit typos ("m132", "m133").
  • The P6 file's project ID is now MOD3-J-2769-BL01-R01-1 (MOD3-J-1 last week). The summary sheet still gives site handover as 12-Feb-2025 (12-Jan-2025 in the weekly report).
  • Several cover fields show #REF! (EAC, top issues), and the invoice log still has stray values of 21,100,000 and 20,900,000.
